item.title: GCHS girls’ basketball falls short in sub-state
item.description: This time, the Garden City High School girls’ basketball team had the home court for the game that mattered the most on Tuesday night at The Garden.

item.title: GCCC to offer workforce training course on electric motors, controls
item.description: Garden City Community College will offer a 40-hour workforce training course titled “Understanding and Troubleshooting Electric Motors and Controls” beginning March 26 through April 23.

item.title: Red Cross to host blood drives across southwest Kansas
item.description: The American Red Cross urges donors to help the national blood supply recover from a severe blood shortage and empower their health by making an appointment to give blood or platelets in March.

item.title: ‘Strangers in Town’ screening, discussion to be held at GCCC
item.description: Garden City Community College will host a screening of the short documentary film “Strangers in Town” and a discussion by Debra Bolton at 3 p.m. on Tuesday, March 31, in the Saffell Library Lobby at Garden City Community College. Members of the community are invited to attend the free program. The program is made possible by Humanities Kansas.

item.title: US Highway 83 tech upgrades underway
item.description: The Kansas Department of Transportation (KDOT) has begun phase two of the U.S. Highway 83 Advanced Technology Project, which will install advanced highway technology along U.S. Highway 83 from Rexford to Liberal.

item.title: BBBS to hold 5K race
item.description: Lace up those running shoes and join Big Brothers Big Sisters of Finney and Kearny Counties for their St. Patrick’s Day 5K and Fun Run on Saturday March 21.

item.title: ASKING ERIC: Parents worry about college-age son’s ‘junk’ diet
item.description: Dear Eric: Our son, who is in college, began losing his hair in high school. It could be genetic, but this does not run in the family. Although he is skinny, he eats terribly. He fills up on junk food, juice and soda. Sometimes he eats nothing.

item.title: County approves emergency declaration for Feb. 17 wildland fire
item.description: The Finney County Commission approved an Emergency Declaration for the Tennis Road Wildland Fire which blazed in northeast Finney County beginning Feb. 17, at its regular meeting on Monday.

item.title: GOT A CLUE?: GCCC’s musical production set for this weekend
item.description: The board game Clue has been portrayed in many forms – the original board game by Parker Brothers, a movie, a play, and even a musical.
